spans.s: 1. न॑व mf(आ)n. (prob. fr. 1. नु॑) new, fresh, recent, young, modern (opp. to सन, पुराण), RV. &c. &c. (often in comp. with a subst., e.g. नवान्न cf. Pāṇ. ii, 1, 49; or with a pp. in the sense of ‘newly, just, lately’ e.g. नवोदित, below)
a young monk, a novice, Buddh.
N. of a son of Uśīnara and Navā, Hariv.
of a son of Viloman, VP.
[cf. Zd. nava; Gk. νέος for νέϝος; Lat. novus; Lith. naújas; Slav. nǒvǔ; Goth. niujis; Angl.Sax. nîwe; HGerm. niuwi; niuwe, neu; Eng. new.]
2. नव m. (√ 4. नु) praise, celebration, L.
4. न॑व in त्रि-णव, q.v. &c. in comp. = ˚वन्.
(आ), f. N. of a woman (see above), Hariv.
